info.title: API.SH: 1001Tracklists
info.description: The 1001Tracklists API from API.SH: public 1001Tracklists data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The tracklists of a DJ or artist, newest first. Each tracklist: id, link, title, artwork, date, views, likes, total and identified tracks, play time, genres, creator, media flags (premium audio, YouTube, SoundCloud, Mixcloud ...) and last change. Also returns the artist's id, slug, name and link. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page. Unknown artists answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1001tracklists-artist-tracklists

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: An artist id from search (e.g. j4dbbd), an artist slug as in 1001tracklists.com/artist/<slug>/ (e.g. armin-van-buuren), the artist's name, or the artist's link.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1-100).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page; leave out for the first page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The DJ charts of 1001tracklists.com: the weekly chart (current or any past week), the daily newcomer chart, the annual chart, the Top 101 producers of a year, the all-time chart, trending and most heard. Each track: id, link, name, artist, title, label (id, name, link), artwork, release date, genre, unique DJ support, tracklist plays, Spotify saves, `track_num_id` (for /track-media) and the players it has (YouTube, SoundCloud, Spotify, Apple Music, shops). Weekly, daily, annual and all-time charts rank tracks by unique DJ support (how many different DJs played them); `rank_change` is the move since the last chart. The producers chart lists each producer (rank, rank change, name, country, artwork, total unique DJ support) with their top tracks. Charts have 20 to 200 rows a page: pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page). Unknown weeks, dates or pages answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1001tracklists-charts

parameters.name: chart
parameters.description: Which chart.

parameters.name: week
parameters.description: Weekly chart only: week number (1-53); needs `year`. Leave out for the current week.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Weekly chart with `week`, annual chart (2000 on) and producers chart (2016 on). Defaults to the current year.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Daily newcomer chart only: the day (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave out for the latest chart.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of the chart (1-20).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search tracklists, artists, tracks, sources (radio shows, events, clubs, festivals), labels or stories. Tracklist results: id, link, title, artwork, date, views, likes, total and identified tracks, play time, genres, creator, media flags (premium audio, YouTube, SoundCloud, Mixcloud ...) and last change. They take the site's filters (order, DJ, source, genre, date range, media, minimum duration, recording type) and come with `facets`: the DJs, sources and genres in the results with their counts and the ids `dj_id`, `source_id` and `genre` take. Artist results: id (for the artist endpoints), slug, name, link, artwork, country, note, track and tracklist counts. Track results: the track fields of the charts. Source results: id, name, link, artwork, tracklist count, type, host. Label results: id, name, link, artwork, country. Story results: id, title, link, summary, image. `total` is the site's result count (rounded above 1,000). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1001tracklists-search

parameters.description: Search words.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: What to search.

parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Tracklists: sort order (last added, last changed, tracklist date, most liked, most viewed, duration).

parameters.name: dj_id

parameters.name: source_id

parameters.name: min_duration

parameters.name: recording

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every player link of a track: YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, Beatport, SoundCloud, Deezer and others. Each: id, type (audio or video), platform, player id, link, embed link, duration, account, who added it. Takes the `track_num_id` the chart, search, tracklist and track endpoints return. A track without links answers an empty list.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1001tracklists-track-media

get.description:
One DJ set, radio show or mix with every track. Returns id, link, short link, title, date, DJs (name, slug, link), sources (radio show, event, venue, club: id, name, link), genres, live flag, views, likes, total and identified tracks, duration, poster (name, points), posted and updated times, tracklist groups, previous and next tracklist of the same source, the set's media (YouTube, Mixcloud, SoundCloud, Spotify, Apple Music: link, embed link, length, official and premium-audio flags) and `tracks`: position, cue time and seconds, `played_with_previous` for tracks mixed together ("w/"), name, artist, title, identified flag (unidentified IDs have no track link), track id and link, every artist (name, slug, link), label, genre, duration, artwork, who identified it, `track_num_id` and the players the track has. Unknown ids answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1001tracklists-tracklist

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A tracklist id, e.g. 1kzv755t (in the tracklist link and the 1001.tl short link). Send id or url.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A 1001tracklists.com/tracklist/... link or a 1001.tl short link. Send id or url.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
